desc: Parse N, P, and compute a primitive (N+1)-th root of unity omega mod P (order exactly N+1).
Implement truncated power series (add, multiply, scalar mul, shift) mod P up to degree N(N-1)/2.
Compute EGFs D_s(x) for s=0..N via BFS layer DP: D_s(x) = x * exp(Σ_{i=0..N} D_{s-i mod (N+1)}(x)), truncated to degree N(N-1)/2.
Compute connected EGF C(x) = log(Σ_s D_s(x) / x) (or equivalently log of total EGF).
Build weighted EGFs C_j(x) for j=0..N: C_j(x) = Σ_s omega^{j*s} * D_s(x) (applied to connected via log).
Apply inverse DFT to extract F_k(x) = (1/(N+1)) * Σ_{j=0..N} omega^{-j*k} * C_j(x) for k = 0..N.
Extract coefficients a_{M,k} = [x^M] F_k(x) * k! * (N-k)! for M = N-1 .. N(N-1)/2, take k = N/2, output a_{M, N/2} mod P.
Output answers for M = N-1 .. N(N-1)/2 separated by spaces.
